Road, 5th Floor, Room No.22, Kolkata): "2026-02-28 | UTKARSH INDIA LIMITED | DITH AUSTRALIA PTY LTD | ERW WELDED GALVANIZED STEEL PIPES ... KOLKATA SEA INCCU1, India | Sydney, AUSTRALIA | 73061919 | 1130438". Additional rows seen: 2026-02-27 Brisbane AU 73061919 BOL 1073382; 2026-02-26 Ashdod, Israel, VRRS LTD, "METAL BEAM CRASH BARRIER WITH ACCESSORIES", HS 73089090, BOL 1057610; 2026-02-25 Sydney AU 73061919 BOL 1015525; 2026-02-24 Sydney AU 73061919 BOL 9957858. Counter on page: "Total Shipments 3259 Records detected", "Trading Partners 32", "Ports 42", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 export rows (plus aggregated supplier/buyer/port summary tables, not individual records). Second slug variant https://importkey.com/countries/india/utkarsh-tubes-pipes-limited shows the same exporter under the older name: "2022-10-02 | UTKARSH TUBES & PIPES LIMITED | TO ORDER | GALVANISED STEEL PIPES | Calcutta, India | Melborne, Australia | 730300 | CCU301872C00", plus 2021-02-12 BOL CCU904872100, 2020-02-09 BOL CCU201873100, 2019-12-05 BOL CCU909879100, 2018-02-04 BOL CCU804876100 (5 rows visible).
note: Export is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L lines with destination, HS code and BOL number exist for both the current name (UTKARSH INDIA LIMITED, 2026 shipments to Australia and Israel) and the former name (UTKARSH TUBES & PIPES LIMITED, 2018-2022 shipments to Melbourne, Australia). Declared HS 730410 (line pipe for oil/gas pipelines) does not match the observed codes: actual shipments are 73061919 (ERW welded galvanized steel pipes), 73089090 (metal beam crash barrier) and 730300 (galvanised steel pipes) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the factual HS should be recorded as 73061919 / 73089090 / 730300 and the declared 730410 treated as incorrect. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection errors for all queries, and company site utkarshindia.com, thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com all returned HTTP 403. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report split was retrieved, so domestic_status is unknown with null evidence rather than inferred from the company website. Revenue/export volume figures: not public in the sources read — null, not estimated. Note the PAN claimed in the input (AAACW4982C) was not verified against any source; the 'state_claimed' field in the input is a search-box placeholder string, not a state.
